title: Can LLM Agents Efficiently Identify Appliance Faults? Insights From Diagnosing a Simulated Appliance
abstract: arXiv:2610.19291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In so-called "Industry 4.0," integrated sensors, analytics tools, and other digital technologies supplement industrial workflows, potentiating enhanced visibility and automation. Prognostics and health management (PHM) and natural language processing (NLP) practitioners alike have explored the application of large language models (LLMs) to industrial asset management, but many prior works' focus on exam-like benchmarks has limited their assessment of LLMs' ability to automate practical operations. Herein, we introduce CoffeeBench, a fault diagnostics task for LLM agents, using a simulated appliance. The LLMs we evaluate struggle to consistently identify faults from the sensor information alone, but the best-performing ones can iteratively refine the fault-option space to eventually obtain a successful diagnosis. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体能高效识别家电故障吗？来自诊断模拟家电的启示
translated_abstract: 在所谓的“工业4.0”时代，集成传感器、分析工具和其他数字技术补充了工业工作流程，为增强可视化和自动化提供了潜力。故障预测与健康管理（PHM）和自然语言处理（NLP）领域的研究者都探索了大语言模型（LLM）在工业资产管理中的应用，但许多先前工作对考试式基准测试的关注限制了其对LLM自动化实际操作能力的评估。在本文中，我们介绍了CoffeeBench，这是一个面向LLM智能体的故障诊断任务，基于一个模拟家电进行。我们评估的LLM难以仅凭传感器信息稳定地识别故障，但表现最佳的模型能够迭代地缩小故障候选空间，最终获得成功的诊断。因此，我们后续的分析聚焦于：通过诊断效率区分不同模型（RQ1）；考察表现滞后模型的……
tldr: 该论文提出了CoffeeBench——一个基于模拟家电的LLM智能体故障诊断基准，发现LLM难以仅凭传感器信息稳定识别故障，但表现最佳的模型能通过迭代缩小故障候选空间实现成功诊断，并进一步分析了不同模型的诊断效率差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CoffeeBench, a fault diagnostics benchmark for LLM agents using a simulated appliance, showing that while LLMs struggle to consistently identify faults from sensor data alone, the best-performing models can iteratively narrow the fault-option space to achieve successful diagnoses, with further analysis focusing on differentiating models by diagnostic efficiency.
